resources.string: Keeps low-latency 1080p hardware H.264 camera stream active for macOS & OBS Studio.
Streaming 1080p Hardware ISP H.264 on TCP :9876

Pxl Cam processes and streams camera video strictly locally over your USB (ADB) or local Wi-Fi connection to your own computer and OBS Studio.

• Zero Cloud Uploads: Video frames never leave your local device or local network.
• Zero Analytics or Ad Tracking: No personal data, biometrics, or usage telemetry is collected or shared with third parties.
• Camera Permission: Used exclusively while the app or streaming service is active to capture hardware ISP video.
